overview: Pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword made out of emerald blocks: more durable than diamond, faster, hitting harder, and twice the enchantability.

2.0.1: The mod menu icon turns up where the loader looks for it.
The readme owns up to what the hoe costs in emeralds.
2.0.0: The full set of tools, with the advancement that unlocks each recipe.
The emerald hoe turns up the odd emerald while tilling.
A tool tells the client what it is, so it looks right in every hand.
